segments.text: A sacrament is a holy ordinance instituted by Christ; wherein by sensible signs, Christ, and the benefits of the new covenant, are represented, sealed, and applied to believers.
Larger Catechism one hundred and sixty-two
A sacrament is an holy ordinance instituted by Christ in his church, to signify, seal, and exhibit unto those that are within the covenant of grace, the benefits of his mediation;
to strengthen and increase their faith, and all other graces; to oblige them to obedience; to testify and cherish their love and communion one with another;
and to distinguish them from those that are without.
